acceptance: Old client/new source, removed field, rollback and simultaneous newer version all obey compatibility states.

positive.fixture: an old pin ignores a new source feature and stays compatible; an interface rollback restores only the presentation

negative.fixture: a lost required field is a breaking diff and a blocked pin; a newer version cannot displace the pin; a data rollback touches no artifact

security_and_source_permissions: Data rollback is never implied by an interface rollback.
